name: Forbright Inc. Class A Common Stock
summary: Forbright, Inc. is the bank holding company for Forbright Bank, offering a range of financial services to consumers and businesses across the United States. Its services span middle market lending, digital consumer banking, strategic advisory, and asset management. The company provides checking and savings accounts, certificates of deposit, and other branch banking services, as well as corporate, fund, healthcare, lender, and real estate financing, along with credit cards. Forbright was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Chevy Chase, Maryland.
